About California Disc Jockey services

Call us on 415-350-5474

We Offer Professional DJs and help you prepare for your special event  from the first phone call to the last dance we’re with you all the way!

If you have any questions or need a price quote regarding our DJ service for your wedding, school dance party or special event don’t hesitate calling  on 415-350-5474 . We are looking forward to serving you and helping you. We deliver top performance through dedication and honest to goodness customer service.

When can we meet with you?

Upon contacting us we can arrange  a consultation meeting in the privacy of your own home or locally to discuss all your needs. If a meeting is not convenient alternative arrangements can be made to suit you –  online or by phone. It’s up to you.

Call Chris in San Francisco on 415-350-5474
